description: Implementation task breakdown for the Kleuw project, suitable for AI agents and humans.

tasks.title: Bootstrap Python package structure
tasks.description: Create the base src/kleuw package layout, including __init__.py and empty module stubs matching the spec (cli, gui, model, schema, hashing, staleness, io, project, utils).

tasks.title: Implement core data models
tasks.description: Implement Python dataclasses or equivalent structures in model.py for files, links, targets, line spans, and region hashes, matching the schema described in kleuw_schema.md.

tasks.title: Implement JSON schema loader and validator
tasks.description: Implement utilities in schema.py to load spec/kleuw.schema.json and validate a project JSON structure. Provide a function validate_project(data: dict) -> list[str] that returns a list of validation error messages (empty if valid).

tasks.title: Implement project IO helpers
tasks.description: In io.py, implement functions to load and save Kleuw project files: load_project(path) -> Project and save_project(path, project). Handle JSON parsing, basic validation via schema.validate_project, and clear error reporting.

tasks.title: Implement project-level operations
tasks.description: In project.py, implement a Project façade class or helper functions for managing files and links (add_file, add_link, find_file_by_id, etc.) to encapsulate core operations used by CLI and GUI.

tasks.title: Implement region and file hashing utilities
tasks.description: In hashing.py, implement functions to compute region hashes and optional file hashes following the normalization rules (UTF-8, universal newlines, 1-based line ranges, no trimming).

tasks.title: Implement staleness detection logic
tasks.description: In staleness.py, implement functions to determine whether a link is stale by recomputing region hashes and comparing them with stored values, handling missing files, invalid ranges, and decode errors.

tasks.title: Implement CLI scaffolding and argument parsing
tasks.description: In cli.py, set up the top-level argparse structure with subcommands (init, add-file, list-files, create-link, list-links, check, recompute, validate, export), including a main() entry point, and minimal stubs for each subcommand.

tasks.title: Implement CLI: init and add-file commands
tasks.description: Implement the behavior for `kleuw init` and `kleuw add-file` using the IO and project helpers. Ensure proper error reporting and JSON project initialization.

tasks.title: Implement CLI: list-files and list-links
tasks.description: Implement listing commands with both human-readable table output and optional --json output consistent with the schema.

tasks.title: Implement CLI: create-link
tasks.description: Implement the `create-link` command to parse region syntax, create link objects, compute region hashes, and append them to the project.

tasks.title: Implement CLI: check and recompute
tasks.description: Implement the `check` command to run staleness detection and the `recompute` command to update stored region hashes as a new baseline, including appropriate exit codes and JSON output.

tasks.title: Implement CLI: validate and export
tasks.description: Implement the `validate` and `export` commands to check project structure and produce summaries (JSON, CSV, text).

tasks.title: Implement basic GUI shell
tasks.description: In gui.py, create the Tkinter main window, menu bar, toolbar, files panel, link workspace shell, and status bar as described in the UI spec, with placeholder callbacks.

tasks.title: Implement GUI file loading and side-by-side viewers
tasks.description: Implement functionality to load files into left/right text viewers with line numbers, scrollbars, and basic navigation.

tasks.title: Implement GUI line selection and relationship creation UI
tasks.description: Implement line-range selection in both viewers, relationship type combo box, swap button, and create-link button wiring to the underlying project/link creation logic.

tasks.title: Implement GUI links panel and navigation to linked regions
tasks.description: Implement a tabular links panel, enabling selection of a link to load corresponding files and scroll to their line ranges. Support delete and edit operations.

tasks.title: Implement GUI staleness check integration
tasks.description: Wire the staleness detection logic into the GUI, including Check Staleness toolbar button, dialog summary, and visual marking of stale links.

tasks.title: Add core unit tests for models and schema validation
tasks.description: Create tests for model creation, serialization/deserialization, and schema validation, ensuring invalid structures are properly reported.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for hashing and staleness logic
tasks.description: Create tests that cover the normalization rules, region hashing for various line ranges, and staleness determination cases (file missing, invalid range, hash mismatch).

tasks.title: Add unit tests for CLI commands
tasks.description: Write tests for the CLI using subprocess or Python-level invocation, verifying behavior of init, add-file, list, create-link, check, recompute, validate, and export commands.

tasks.title: Add basic GUI tests (headless-safe)
tasks.description: Implement a minimal set of GUI tests that can run in a headless environment where possible, and gracefully skip when Tk cannot initialize.

tasks.title: Create example project and sample files
tasks.description: Populate the examples/ directory with a sample Kleuw project JSON and a small set of files demonstrating links, including stale and fresh relationships.

tasks.title: Align documentation with implementation
tasks.description: Review the spec documents (requirements, schema, CLI, UI, staleness) and update them to reflect any implementation decisions or deviations discovered during development.

tasks.title: Implement 'Recent Projects' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'File > Recent Projects' menu item to display a list of recently opened projects and allow the user to open them.

tasks.title: Implement 'Exit' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'File > Exit' menu item to close the application, prompting to save unsaved changes.

tasks.title: Implement 'Undo' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Edit > Undo' menu item to undo the last action.

tasks.title: Implement 'Redo' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Edit > Redo' menu item to redo the last undone action.

tasks.title: Implement 'Delete Link' menu items
tasks.description: Implement the 'Edit > Delete Link' and 'Links > Delete Link' menu items to delete the selected link(s) in the links panel.

tasks.title: Implement 'Preferences' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Edit > Preferences' menu item to open a preferences dialog.

tasks.title: Implement 'Toggle Files Panel' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'View > Toggle Files Panel' menu item to show or hide the files panel.

tasks.title: Implement 'Toggle Links Panel' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'View > Toggle Links Panel' menu item to show or hide the links panel.

tasks.title: Implement 'Increase Font Size' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'View > Increase Font Size' menu item to increase the font size in the text viewers.

tasks.title: Implement 'Decrease Font Size' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'View > Decrease Font Size' menu item to decrease the font size in the text viewers.

tasks.title: Implement 'Toggle Line Wrapping' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'View > Toggle Line Wrapping' menu item to enable or disable line wrapping in the text viewers.

tasks.title: Implement 'Edit Link' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Links > Edit Link' menu item to open the edit dialog for the selected link.

tasks.title: Implement 'Recompute Hashes' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Links > Recompute Hashes' menu item to recompute the hashes for all links.

tasks.title: Implement 'Validate Project' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Tools > Validate Project' menu item to validate the current project against the schema.

tasks.title: Implement 'Export Summary' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Tools > Export Summary' menu item to export a summary of the project.

tasks.title: Implement 'About' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Help > About' menu item to display an 'About' dialog.

tasks.title: Implement 'Keyboard Shortcuts' menu item
tasks.description: Implement the 'Help > Keyboard Shortcuts' menu item to display a dialog with a list of keyboard shortcuts.

tasks.title: Fix 'Delete Link' menu item
tasks.description: Implement a single 'Delete Link' menu item, deciding on the best location for it. Update the UI specification and other documentation to reflect this change. This corrects the incomplete implementation of T-029.

tasks.title: Implement 'Preferences' dialog functionality
tasks.description: Implement the 'Edit > Preferences' dialog to manage application settings, such as font size and line wrapping, as described in the UI specification. The current implementation is a placeholder.
